# WebABC

> WebABC (https://webabc.ir) is a web design, development, and SEO agency serving clients in the Middle East and internationally. Services span custom web development, WordPress/WooCommerce, e-commerce, SEO, and website maintenance. The site is available in English, Persian (Farsi), and Arabic; URLs below use the English (`/en`) versions — swap `/en` for `/fa` or `/ar` for the other locales.

## Company

- [Home](https://webabc.ir/en): Overview of WebABC's services, agency workflow, and results.
- [About](https://webabc.ir/en/about): WebABC's team, mission, and experience.
- [Contact](https://webabc.ir/en/contact): Free consultation and project inquiry form.
- [FAQ](https://webabc.ir/en/faq): Frequently asked questions about working with WebABC.
- [Privacy Policy](https://webabc.ir/en/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling terms.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://webabc.ir/en/services): Directory of all service offerings.
- [SEO](https://webabc.ir/en/services/seo): Technical, on-page, off-page, and local SEO.
- [Local SEO](https://webabc.ir/en/services/local-seo): Google Business Profile and local search ranking.
- [Web Development](https://webabc.ir/en/services/web-development): Custom web application development (React, Next.js, Node.js).
- [WordPress Development](https://webabc.ir/en/services/wordpress-development): Custom WordPress and WooCommerce builds.
- [Web Design](https://webabc.ir/en/services/web-design): UI/UX design, branding, and responsive layouts.
- [E-commerce Development](https://webabc.ir/en/services/ecommerce): Shopify, WooCommerce, and headless storefront builds.
- [Content Creation](https://webabc.ir/en/services/content-creation): SEO blogging, copywriting, and content strategy.
- [Link Building](https://webabc.ir/en/services/link-building): White-hat backlink acquisition and outreach.
- [Speed Optimization](https://webabc.ir/en/services/speed-optimization): Core Web Vitals and page-speed improvements.
- [UI/UX Audit](https://webabc.ir/en/services/ui-ux-audit): User experience diagnostic audits.
- [Website Maintenance](https://webabc.ir/en/services/website-maintenance): Ongoing updates, backups, and security monitoring.

## Free Tools

- [All Tools](https://webabc.ir/en/tools): Directory of free SEO and developer utilities.
- [SEO Headline Analyzer](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/headline-analyzer): Score headlines for length, power words, and sentiment.
- [SEO Title Checker](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/seo-title-checker): Preview title tags and meta descriptions as Google renders them.
- [Website Cost Calculator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/cost-calculator): Estimate web project budgets by platform, pages, and features.
- [Readability Checker](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/readability-checker): Flesch reading-ease and grade-level scoring.
- [Keyword Density Analyzer](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/keyword-density-analyzer): Check keyword frequency and avoid over-optimization.
- [URL Slug Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/slug-generator): Generate clean, SEO-friendly URL slugs.
- [UTM Link Builder](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/utm-builder): Build campaign-tagged tracking URLs.
- [SERP Snippet Preview](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/serp-preview): Preview a page's Google search result snippet.
- [Social Media Preview](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/social-media-preview): Preview Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn link cards.
- [Privacy Policy Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/privacy-policy-generator): Generate a GDPR/CCPA-style privacy policy.
- [CSS Glassmorphism Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/glassmorphism-generator): Generate glassmorphism CSS effects.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/json-formatter): Format and validate JSON entirely client-side.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/robots-generator): Build crawler directives for robots.txt.
- [People Also Ask Explorer](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/paa-scraper): Explore common "People Also Ask" question patterns.
